scope: MFM army-construction reconciliation is the implementation scope. These selected executable-rule comparisons supplement it. Full current faction PDF reconciliation, codex replacements, datasheet characteristic/weapon updates and other unlisted rules are unqualified and remain separate bounded work. The World Eaters current PDF was captured and inspected but no complete semantic reconciliation is claimed.
access: Web retrieval of interactive MFM returned HTTP403. Normal in-app-browser and ordinary curl access succeeded without special headers, challenges, credentials, alternate restricted endpoints or bypass. Public official PDF downloads succeeded.
